fields.v: No SDD approach. Agent Skills (open Agent Skills format: directory with SKILL.md name/description, instructions, optional scripts and references, loaded on demand) under three access conditions: none, curated (human-selected), automatic invocation from an installed library; crossed with memory off/on (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instruction files and agent notes). Harnesses: Ginkley (BraneMatrix), Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, each 'at its latest release', exact version to be recorded

Skill packages (SKILL.md plus scripts, templates, reference material) contributed by domain experts; Skill content not disclosed (property of contributors), only purpose described. Task package: prompt, input assets, pinned toolset, reference solution, golden values, deterministic verifier
N/A (not SDD). Run protocol: reset workspace/session/memory -> agent run under fixed budgets -> collect artefacts, logs, tokens, cost, time -> verify -> aggregate repeats

4 tasks (2 materials science, 2 biology); planned 288 runs per model (4 harnesses x 3 Skill conditions x 2 memory modes x 4 tasks x 3 repeats), 3,168 runs for 11 models (1,584 under memory off)
